prose: Anthropic's claude-api skill now automates eval design and hill-climbing: /claude-api build-eval constructs an evaluation inside your codebase, and /claude-api hillclimb improves the app against it one change at a time with a held-out set to catch overfitting. The accompanying article lays out the principles first: model capability is jagged, so cases chosen because today's model fails them can mislead; good evals share common design elements; and improving against an eval without fooling yourself requires discipline the held-out set enforces. Examples close out the piece.
highlights: New claude-api skill commands: build-eval and hillclimb
build-eval constructs an evaluation inside your codebase
hillclimb improves the app one change at a time against the eval
A held-out example set catches overfitting to the eval
Principles: model capability is jagged; case selection by current failure can mislead
